english_definition: A small card with a person's name and professional information (such as occupation, business phone number, e-mail address, etc.).
A malfunction in a computer's printer or a photocopier or similar device occurring when sheets of paper become jammed inside.
A board on which messages may be posted, especially one in a public space.
To give something to a responsible person.
To affect someone strongly and often favorably.
Actively engaged in an assigned task, duty or occupation.
To pick up the receiver of a telephone, generally with the intention of making a phone call.
To inform one's workplace or school that one temporarily cannot attend work or school due to illness.
To supersede; to come to be used instead of someone or something.
